pluginDescription: Multi-operator timed CQ rotation with sequential and random modes.
rotationOverview: Rotate CQ calls among multiple operators. Each operator transmits CQ for a configurable duration before switching to the next. Configure the operator callsign list below.
rotationOverviewDesc: Ensure at least 2 operator callsigns are configured before use.
enabledDesc: When enabled, operators will take turns transmitting CQ at the configured interval.
operatorCallsignsDesc: Enter operator callsigns in rotation order, one per line. At least 2 callsigns required.
intervalSecondsDesc: How long each operator transmits CQ before switching.
modeDesc: Sequential rotates in fixed order, Random picks the next operator randomly.
